'''Spacer's tape''' was an item sometimes used to repair [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. It was sold in rolls.

[[Teeloo]]'s [[YT-1210 light freighter/Legends|YT-1210 light freighter]] ''[[Neeva-Beelo]]'', when he first flew it, would have needed several rolls of it, plus new pieces, to be repaired.
